while True:
    result = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, direction='sent', min_created_at=min_date, max_created_at=max_date, page_index=page, page_limit=20)

    transactions.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(len(transactions))
print(transactions[:2])
